questions.learningObjective: Analyze how digital divide applies in a computing setting.

stimulus.body: Working set: 1600 users under review for digital divide.

questions.stem: An audit samples 1600 users where digital divide is relevant. What does digital divide refer to in this setting?

questions.hint: Who has access and who does not?
